QuestInfo.name: A Letter Across Ages
QuestInfo.0: You could not get any information on Freud because you could not speak to Afrien. Could Freud truly be gone? It's hard for you to believe.
QuestInfo.1:
You cannot let Freud go that easily. You can't be sure until you see his grave, or meet someone who saw him draw his final breath. For now, writing him a letter will help you cope. 

#r#eTip. Eliminate Gold Beach monsters to get a #t4034061#.
QuestInfo.2: You sent Freud your letter. Perhaps someday, somehow, he will receive your message.

0.0: I just... I can't accept it. Not until I see his grave, or meet someone who witnessed his end. Freud is alive... At least to me.
0.1: If he's out there somewhere, I'm sure he's by the ocean. He so loved watching the tide roll in and out... Maybe I'll write him a letter... A message in a bottle.

yes.0: I'll need a #r#t4034061##k to put my letter in. There are plenty of them on the beach at #bGold Beach#k, since people are too lazy to throw their junk away properly.

no.0: ...I must be crazy. A letter in a glass bottle? It doesn't make any sense.
